'''2014 Match Play Championship Consolation Mike Pistone DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Pistone]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Consolation).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Consolation
